{
  "name": "@smart/outlet-locator-feature-app",
  "version": "1.1.1",
  "types": "lib/index.d.ts",
  "files": [
    "lib/*.d.ts"
  ],
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=18"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "preinstall": "npx only-allow pnpm",
    "dev": "cross-env DEV=1 run-p watch start",
    "prebuild": "rm -rf dist",
    "build": "webpack --mode production",
    "build:dev": "webpack --mode development",
    "ci": "run-p compile compile:graphql build format:check lint test",
    "compile": "tsc --pretty",
    "compile:graphql": "tsc --pretty --project src/graphql/tsconfig.json",
    "predeploy": "cdk bootstrap --app \"npx aws-simple synth\"",
    "deploy": "cdk deploy --no-asset-metadata --app \"npx aws-simple synth\"",
    "postdeploy": "aws-simple upload --yes",
    "format": "prettier --write .",
    "format:check": "prettier --check .",
    "pregenerate-graphql-types": "node ./node_modules/@smart/aem-utils/dist/cli/fetch-aem-schema.js --path=src/graphql/ && prettier --write \"src/graphql/aem-@(dev|sit|stage|prod)-schema.json\"",
    "generate-graphql-types": "graphql-codegen --config graphql.config.ts",
    "generate-graphql-types:watch": "graphql-codegen --config graphql.config.ts --watch",
    "lint": "eslint '**/*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}'",
    "start": "cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--require=source-map-support/register aws-simple start",
    "test": "jest --coverage --silent --passWithNoTests",
    "watch": "run-p \"build:dev --watch\" \"generate-graphql-types:watch\" \"compile --watch --preserveWatchOutput\"",
    "prepare": "husky"

analysis.summary: The PR contains a high-severity functional regression in the checkout flow and a configuration bug where hardcoded credentials bypass environment variables, alongside a major map provider migration that violates the stated PR scope.

bugs.title: Broken Navigation in Checkout Flow
bugs.description: The 'Confirm Selection' button (used in the 'checkout' variant) had the call to 'redirectToNextPage(e)' removed. Additionally, the component no longer accepts 'redirectToNextPage' as a prop, even though the parent 'Outlets.tsx' still attempts to pass it.
bugs.risk: In the checkout flow, clicking the primary action button to select an outlet will now do nothing other than update local state and tracking. The user will be unable to proceed to the next page, effectively breaking the purchase/selection funnel.

bugs.title: Hardcoded Credentials Bypass Environment Configuration
bugs.description: The MAP_API_KEY is hardcoded as a constant string in the source code. This bypasses the 'LOCATION_API_KEY' environment variable configured in 'aws-simple.config.mjs'.
bugs.risk: This prevents environment-specific configuration. Production builds will attempt to use the hardcoded key instead of the provisioned AWS credentials, potentially leading to usage limit exhaustion, billing errors, or authentication failures if the hardcoded key is restricted or revoked.

bugs.title: Map Re-centering via Destructive Remounting
bugs.description: The map component lacks a useEffect to handle updates to the 'location' prop (center). Instead, 'location' is used in the main initialization effect dependency array. This causes the entire MapLibre instance to be destroyed and re-initialized every time the user performs a search or updates their location.
bugs.risk: This results in significant performance degradation and 'incorrect behavior' from a user perspective. Every search will cause the map to flicker and lose all current state (zoom level, bearing, and pitch) because it remounts from scratch instead of calling map.setCenter().

bugs.title: PR Scope Violation: Undocumented Map Migration
bugs.description: The PR title 'Feature/techus update node pnpm' indicates a tooling upgrade. However, the changes include a complete migration from HERE Maps to AWS Maps/MapLibre, including the removal of the HERE SDK and the introduction of entirely new map components and logic.
bugs.risk: Massive functional changes are hidden under a tooling upgrade title. This bypasses appropriate feature review and testing for a major architectural shift in how location services are rendered.

notBugs.reason: The removal of '--' in the watch script (e.g., 'build:dev --watch') is correct for pnpm/modern npm versions when arguments are passed to a script that directly invokes a CLI like webpack.
While the .enlargeMap class is defined twice in map.module.scss with different values, it is a code quality/style issue rather than a high-severity functional bug.
